The Core Concept

What if every game had just one button — your keyboard?

World of Promptcraft is a 3D multiplayer RPG where the entire interface is a text prompt. There are no action bars, no dialog trees, no skill menus. You type what you want to do — and the game's AI makes it real.

Every NPC is a fully autonomous AI agent with its own memory, personality, and mood. They remember your name, your past actions, and how you treated them. Befriend a merchant and she'll give you discounts. Insult a guard and he'll hold a grudge.

Combat rewards creativity — a plain "I attack" deals glancing damage, while a vivid "I vault off the crumbling wall and drive my blazing blade into the dragon's eye" can be devastating.

"The most innovative RPG interface I've seen in years. It's like playing D&D with a Dungeon Master that never sleeps."
— Early alpha player
Features

A World That Listens

AI-Powered NPCs

Every character has a real brain. Talk, trade, flirt, threaten, befriend — they remember everything and react in character.

Creative Combat

Describe your attack. The more vivid and imaginative, the more damage you deal. Physical, fire, ice, lightning, holy, dark — your words choose your element.

Build by Typing

"Place a stone bridge across this river." The World Spirit agent makes it real. Build towers, walls, houses — all by describing them.

Create NPCs

"Make a grumpy dwarf blacksmith named Ironhide who hates magic." The Architect agent brings your character to life with full AI personality.

Infinite Living World

Seven distinct biomes across an infinite procedural world. From the Crystal Tundra to the Blasted Suarezlands, anchored by hand-crafted landmarks.

Multiplayer

Explore with friends. See each other in the world, chat, and interact with the same NPCs. No download, no install — just open your browser.

How to Play

Your Keyboard Is All You Need

1

Choose Your Hero

Pick a name, race (Human, Elf, Dwarf, Orc), and faction (Alliance or Horde). You spawn in a vast fantasy world.

2

Explore the World

Walk through lush forests, volcanic badlands, frozen tundras, and ancient ruins. Every step reveals something new.

3

Find an NPC

Click any character you meet. Instead of a dialog tree, you get a text box. This is your only interface.

4

Type Anything

Say hello, ask for a quest, offer a trade, start a fight, tell a joke, propose a deal, or try to pickpocket them. The AI responds instantly.

5

Watch the World React

Damage numbers fly, particle effects ignite, NPCs emote, weather changes, music swells — all driven by your words.

Real Examples of What You Can Type
You: "I swing my iron sword at the bandit's exposed flank, channeling all my fury into a burning arc of fire!"
Bandit: "Argh! A devastating hit — 32 fire damage! The stench of scorched leather fills the air."
You: "Hello there, could you tell me about this这个地方? Do you have any work for a wandering adventurer?"
Elder Mira: "Welcome, traveler. The Crystal Lake has been tainted by dark magic. Bring me 5 vials of purified water and I'll reward you handsomely."
You: "World Builder, construct a watchtower on this hill with a beacon at the top."
World Spirit: "The ground rumbles as stone rises from the earth. A watchtower now stands atop the hill, its beacon casting warm light across the valley."
